abilities.desc_zh:
战斗开始时有6个护盾增益，每个护盾增益将一次攻击造成的伤害上限限制为对手攻击力的80%。
护盾起效状态下，犀牛受到燃烧和震击伤害强度减少35%。
被近战攻击命中或者防御近战攻击一次消耗一个护盾。
护盾全消耗完之后进入8秒充能状态，倒计时结束后重新获得6个护盾。
远程攻击30%几率触发流血，造成攻击力60%的伤害，持续5秒
abilities.desc_en: Starts the fight with 6 Shield Buffs <s>each capping damage from one attack to {{var_1}} of the opponent's Attack Rating. </s>which are removed each time Rhinox is hit by a Basic or Heavy Melee Attack.

abilities.desc_zh: 基本近战攻击：对流血状态的敌人额外造成20%的伤害  // 无图标
abilities.desc_en: Basic Melee Attacks: +{{var_5}} damage against Bleeding targets.

abilities.desc_zh:
重击命中时施加4秒的能量锁定，并即时扣除对方最大能量值的12%。
触发一次能量锁定后，16秒以内再次触发的概率为30%，16秒后恢复100%。
护盾防御能力提升，每个护盾增益将一次攻击造成的伤害上限限制为对手攻击力的60%，如果对手单次攻击的伤害超过60%，则会被施加1层震击，造成犀牛攻击力160%的伤害，持续4秒。//用例：对方出近战重击击中犀牛，由于重击是攻击力的80%>60%，则会被施加震击。但如果犀牛防御，则不会触发震击。
abilities.desc_en:
Overclock
Shield Buffs are more effective, but also more volatile.
Passive: Rhinox ekes out extra performance from Shield Buffs, further reducing damage to {{var_15}} of the opponent's Attack Rating. When reducing the damage suffered by an attack, the extra strain causes them to explode, inflicting {{var_16}} Attack as Shock Damage.
+approximately {{var_17}} per level

abilities.desc_zh:
100%几率破坏目标的武器系统，驱散最多1个近战、远程或特殊伤害增益。
// 测试用例：对方有2层近战增益，2层远程增益，1层特殊伤害增益，则SP1击中后，对方被驱散3个增益，还剩1层近战增益，1层远程增益，0层特殊伤害增益
abilities.desc_en: Tactical Gore - A sensible, well-thought-out impaling is an effective way to settle an argument.

abilities.desc_zh: 40%概率触发流血，施加攻击力60%的伤害，持续8秒
abilities.desc_en: <s>{{var_18}}</s> {{var_19}} chance to gore the target's weapons systems, Nullifying up to 1 Melee, Ranged, or Special Damage Buffs.

abilities.desc_zh: 敌人 - 黄蜂、蝎子 - +{{var_35}}~{{var_36}} 攻击评级。
伤害性减益持续时间+{{var_37}}~{{var_38}} 更长。此外，联盟任务中的攻击评级增加+{{var_39}}~{{var_40}}。
abilities.desc_en: Damaging Debuffs lasts +{{var_37}}~{{var_38}} longer. Additionally, Attack Rating is increased by +{{var_39}}~{{var_40}} in Alliance Missions.

abilities.desc_zh: <s>冲击波会在战斗开始时以及每次 {{var_42}} 时生成 {{var_41}} 能量球。 </s> 冲击波的冲击会造成 {{var_43}}~{{var_44}} 更多伤害。
abilities.desc_en: <s>Shockwave generates {{var_41}}Energy Charges at the start of the fight and every {{var_42}}. </s> Shockwave's Shocks deal {{var_43}}~{{var_44}} more damage.

abilities.desc_zh: 盟友 - 猎豹、机器人、擎天柱 - +{{var_45}}~{{var_46}} 装甲。
abilities.desc_en: - Allies - Cheetor, Dinobot, Optimus Primal - +{{var_45}}~{{var_46}} Armor.

abilities.desc_zh: 只要 Primal 的队伍中有 2 个或更多野兽战争机器人，野兽战争角色的重击就会为 {{var_49}} 提供 {{var_47}}~{{var_48}} 攻击评级并净化伤害减益。
abilities.desc_en: Heavy Attacks of Beast Wars characters grant {{var_47}}~{{var_48}} Attack Rating for {{var_49}} and Purify Damaging Debuffs as long as there are 2 or more Beast Wars bots on Primal’s team.

abilities.desc_zh: 每次重击后，该机器人都会获得野兽之怒增益，使攻击有 {{var_50}}~{{var_51}} 机会无法被 {{var_52}} 阻挡。
abilities.desc_en: After each Heavy Attack, this bot gains a Beast Fury buff that grants Attacks a {{var_50}}~{{var_51}} chance to be Unblockable for {{var_52}}.

abilities.desc_zh:
